messages.subject: Series B raise - instructing Whitfield Carter
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Good to catch up last week. We'd like to formally instruct you on our Series B. Westbridge Growth Capital are leading with c.£11m, and our existing investors Calderbrook and Aldridge Seed are following on for £2m and £1m respectively. Target is £14m at a £56m pre.

Marcus Pell at Westbridge is their lead partner. Their counsel is Birchall Stone. Can you and the team take this forward?

Marcus

messages.subject: RE: Series B raise - instructing Whitfield Carter
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Delighted - we'd be glad to act. James Osei will lead day to day with Elena Marchetti supporting; I'll stay close as partner.

We'll open the matter as Project Falcon and send our engagement letter today. As a first step we'll draft the term sheet for your review and run a conflicts check against Birchall Stone. Could Priya share the latest cap table and the data room link?

Best,
Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
